svg.title: Attachment
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: attachment set to Zip ties: adds or removes the zip-tie holes and the wing or slot openings for the strap. Marked in red: 1, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket, removed. The body edge, the pocket, the seat and the wall notch stay where they were.
